title: Initial incident notice later than 24 hours
fix: Notify the competent authority within 24 hours of becoming aware

title: Detailed incident report later than one month
fix: Send the detailed report no later than one month after the initial notice

title: No incident notification procedure in the plan
fix: Add the 24-hour initial notice and one-month detailed report steps

title: Risk assessment review cycle longer than four years or missing
fix: Re-assess whenever necessary and at least every four years

title: First risk assessment later than nine months after notification
fix: Complete the first risk assessment within nine months of the designation notice

title: Hazard category missing from the all-hazards assessment
fix: Assess natural, accidental, public health and antagonistic risks

title: No cross-sector dependency analysis
fix: Record which sectors depend on you and which you depend on

title: No liaison officer named as point of contact
fix: Name a liaison officer or equivalent as the contact for the authority

title: Resilience measure area missing from the plan
fix: Cover all Art. 13(1) measure areas in the resilience plan
